text:
elya: spike in eu-west2: hundreds of GPU attaches stuck 'waiting for scratch', users seeing queued jobs. Ops dashboard shows local NVMe latencies and a pile of janitor read retries. anyone awake? :eyes:
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west2 scratch_iops_utilization 95% for 9m; attach_fail_rate 16%; affected services: gpu-provisioner, batch-scheduler.
samir: i'm on it. quick `iostat -x 1 3` on a sample host shows:
```
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s  r/s  w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s  avgrq-sz  aqu-sz  await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         0.00  80.00  1.00 250.00  4.0   2048.0  16.4      2.3    75.2   0.25  99.50
```
meaning heavy write-backed read amplification. looks like janitor compaction + overlayfs background syncs hitting the drives.
fiona: timeline: we had a large autoscale event 2m before this and a scheduled ephemeral-cleaner deep-verify window (was supposed to be jittered). i think the scale and cleaner aligned; plus we recently flipped overlayfs flush-on-close to true for a perf experiment. combo is nasty.
harry: mitigation candidates: 1) pause deep-verify on busy nodepools, 2) revert overlayfs flush flag for that pool, 3) gate attaches using a per-node iops_budget metric rather than only free_scratch_slots, 4) temporarily favor pools in other regions if capacity permits.
elya: do it. post exact commands so ops can audit.
samir: running canary patches now:
```
# pause janitor deep-verify for pool
kubectl -n infra patch configmap ephemeral-cleaner --patch '{"data":{"deepVerify":"false","concurrency":"1"}}'
# revert overlayfs flag on nodepool
gcloud compute instances set-metadata <node-template> --metadata overlayfs.flush_on_close=false
# attach gate: require iops_budget >= 250
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"name":"attach-iops-gate","expr":"iops_budget >= 250"}'
```
ops-bot: CHANGE: ephemeral-cleaner deepVerify=false applied by samir at 4467008062. rollback scheduled at 4467008362 if attach success does not improve.
fiona: canary AZ shows attach queue drop 240->40 in ~70s and nvme util down to ~66%. revert overlayfs change is rolling, should finish in 2m.
harry: short-term routing: i'm adding a soft preference to scheduler to place critical attaches in eu-west1 and eu-central1 if they have spare iops headroom. small cost increase but avoids customer impact.
elya: please also add an alert for overlayfs.flush_on_close toggles so this doesn't surprise us. we need a postmortem item: why did the flush experiment land in the same pool that had jitter disabled?
samir: noted. creating incident tasks:
- audit cleaner jitter config across regions (owner: infra/storage)
- add iops_budget metric to provisioner admission (owner: infra/provisioner)
- add overlayfs toggle alert (owner: eng-platform)

fiona: follow-up: once stable, we'll re-enable deep-verify with high jitter and single concurrency. also schedule a chaos test in staging that simulates scale + scrub overlap.
elya: timeline: canary stable, rolling to remaining AZs with 30s spacing. keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: NOTE: attach success rate improved to 96% in eu-west2 at 4467008120. incident severity downgraded to P2.
